fragrances.name: Coco Noir
fragrances.description: A dark, polished patchouli-rose: grapefruit, bergamot and orange open brightly before rose, jasmine, geranium and a hint of peach, and the base settles into patchouli, incense, sandalwood, tonka and vanilla with a warm clove edge. Dressy and composed, it reads best in the evening and in cooler months.

fragrances.name: Angel Nova
fragrances.description: Juicy raspberry and lychee lead into a bright, jammy rose that dries down over peppery Akigalawood and a soft benzoin warmth. Far fruitier and lighter than the original Angel, with none of its patchouli-caramel weight.

fragrances.name: Libre Intense
fragrances.description: Libre's lavender and orange blossom pairing pushed into warmer territory: mandarin and bergamot brighten the lavender, jasmine and orchid fill out the heart, and a creamy vanilla-tonka base with ambergris and vetiver takes over. Richer and sweeter than the original, it suits cooler days and evenings.
cons: Sweet enough to cloy in heat

fragrances.name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A soft, powdery rose: iris, peony and lily-of-the-valley lead into rose with a touch of apricot and peach, then settle on a smooth base of vanilla, tonka, musk and sandalwood. Romantic and polished, it is easy to wear by day.
pros: Bottle dressed with a couture bow
cons: Sweeter and softer than the chypre-style Miss Dior of old

fragrances.name: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A sugary white floral: creamy gardenia, jasmine and frangipani sweetened by red berries, pear blossom and a touch of mandarin, over a brown-sugar and light patchouli drydown. Cheerful and girlish rather than heady; the gardenia here is soft and candied.

fragrances.name: Very Good Girl
fragrances.description: A red-fruit take on Good Girl: tart red currant and lychee over a sweet rose, settling into vanilla with a dry vetiver edge. Brighter and fruitier than the original, without its tuberose and cocoa depth.

fragrances.name: La Vie Est Belle L'Élixir
fragrances.description: A fruitier, darker La Vie Est Belle: raspberry, a boozy liqueur accord and bergamot open onto green violet leaf and rose, then sink into cocoa butter with a leather and cedar backbone. Sweet and dense, it leans toward cooler weather and evenings.
cons: Violet-leather twist may not suit fans of the original

fragrances.name: Gabrielle Chanel
fragrances.description: A bright, sheer white-floral bouquet of jasmine, tuberose, orange blossom and ylang-ylang, lifted by grapefruit, mandarin and blackcurrant and resting on soft musk, sandalwood and orris. Radiant and abstract rather than heady, with a clean, luminous feel.

fragrances.name: Alien Goddess
fragrances.description: A creamy jasmine-vanilla scent: bergamot and a coconut-water accord open onto jasmine and powdery heliotrope, over a warm Bourbon vanilla and cashmeran base. Softer and sunnier than Alien, it trades that perfume's dense amber for a smooth, coconut-tinged vanilla.

fragrances.name: My Way
fragrances.description: A clean, sunny white floral: bergamot and orange blossom up top, a creamy tuberose-jasmine heart and a soft vanilla-musk base. Bright and easygoing, it sits between fresh and creamy.

fragrances.name: Mon Paris Intensément
fragrances.description: A rosier, deeper Mon Paris: raspberry, blackcurrant and pear over a heart of rose, peony and datura, settling on vanilla, patchouli, benzoin and cashmeran softened by white musk. A sweet fruity chypre that works day or night.
cons: Close to the original Mon Paris
Can feel heavy in hot weather

fragrances.name: Chance Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A peppery floral chypre: pink pepper opens onto jasmine and powdery iris, drying down to earthy patchouli, white musk and a soft vanilla warmth. Cheerful yet polished, and warmer than the Eau Fraîche and Eau Tendre versions.

fragrances.name: Goddess
fragrances.description: A lavender-vanilla gourmand: aromatic lavender, ginger and a touch of cocoa open onto layered vanillas that carry the whole wear. Soft, warm and approachable.

fragrances.name: Good Girl Blush
fragrances.description: A soft floral take on Good Girl: bergamot and a hint of bitter almond lead into peony and ylang-ylang, settling on a smooth vanilla-coumarin base. Lighter and fresher than the original, without its dark cocoa and coffee.

fragrances.name: Paradoxe Intense
fragrances.description: A warmer, more ambery Paradoxe: neroli and bergamot over a dense jasmine heart, with a moss accord and a musky amber-vanilla base giving it more depth than the original. Smooth and modern, leaning toward evening wear.

fragrances.name: Donna Born in Roma Intense
fragrances.description: A thicker, vanilla-forward Donna Born in Roma: Bourbon vanilla and amber lead from the start, jasmine sits in the heart, and a balsamic benzoin base carries the wear. Warm and sweet, made for cooler weather and nights out.

fragrances.name: Devotion
fragrances.description: A gourmand orange-blossom scent: candied lemon on top, orange blossom with a creamy panna-cotta accord and a hint of rum in the heart, and a soft vanilla base. Brighter than many dessert-style gourmands.

fragrances.name: Black Opium Le Parfum
fragrances.description: A deeper, vanilla-heavy Black Opium: pear, cinnamon and green mandarin open onto jasmine and orange blossom, then layered vanillas meet coffee and a touch of patchouli. Denser and warmer than the original, aimed at cold-weather evenings.
cons: Close to other Black Opium flankers

fragrances.name: Angel Elixir
fragrances.description: A creamy white-floral gourmand: pink pepper opens onto orange blossom, ylang-ylang, jasmine and sandalwood over Bourbon vanilla and a dry woody amber. It shares Angel's sweetness but skips the patchouli, so it wears creamier and more floral.

fragrances.name: Bloom Ambrosia di Fiori
fragrances.description: A richer rose-and-orris take on Gucci Bloom: jasmine and honeysuckle open onto a dense tuberose heart, deepened by Damask rose and a velvety orris base. Lush and heady, with more weight than the original.
cons: Indolic edge may not suit everyone

fragrances.name: Sì Passione
fragrances.description: Juicy blackcurrant and pear sharpened with pink pepper and grapefruit, moving into rose, jasmine and a touch of pineapple over a warm vanilla, cedar and patchouli base. More fruit-forward and playful than the original Sì, with an openly sweet character.
pros: Cheerful fruity sweetness that is easy to like
Holds well for an eau de parfum
cons: Sweetness can turn cloying in heat
Less nuanced than the original Sì

fragrances.name: L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge
fragrances.description: Givenchy's white-flower L'Interdit given a hotter edge: blood orange and ginger open onto tuberose and jasmine warmed by pimento leaf, before a sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver drydown. Spicier and more vivid than the standard EDP while keeping its darker undertone.
pros: Spicy citrus twist keeps the white flowers lively
Stands apart from typical tuberose scents
cons: Shares much of its structure with L'Interdit EDP

fragrances.name: Fame
fragrances.description: A creamy mango opening lifted by bergamot moves into a soft jasmine heart threaded with incense, drying down to sandalwood and vanilla. Sweet and fruity up front, but the incense keeps it from reading as pure candy.
cons: Mango can turn syrupy on some skin

fragrances.name: Perfect
fragrances.description: Tart rhubarb and a green daffodil note open onto a milky almond heart that settles into the soft, slightly musky woods of cashmeran and cedar. Creamy and comforting, with a gentle nutty sweetness and a tart green edge.
cons: Can read as generic sweet on skin

fragrances.name: Coco Mademoiselle Intense
fragrances.description: A deeper, more ambery Coco Mademoiselle: orange, bergamot and lemon over rose and jasmine, with the patchouli pushed forward and warmed by tonka, vanilla, labdanum and white musk. Polished and dense, and more evening-leaning than the original.
pros: Richer, warmer take on a modern classic

fragrances.name: N°5 L'Eau
fragrances.description: A lighter, citrus-led reading of N°5: lemon, mandarin, orange and bergamot brighten the aldehydes, with ylang-ylang, jasmine and rose in the heart and a clean base of white musk, orris and cedar. Airy and modern while keeping the recognisable soapy-floral signature.
pros: N°5 character in an easier, fresher form
cons: Aldehydes can read soapy or old-fashioned to some

fragrances.name: J'adore Parfum d'Eau
fragrances.description: An alcohol-free, water-based take on J'adore built around jasmine sambac, neroli, magnolia and honeysuckle with a green edge. Softer and more transparent than the classic EDP, it wears as a sheer white-floral veil close to the skin.
pros: Easy for daytime and the office

fragrances.name: Idôle L'Intense
fragrances.description: A richer, warmer variation on Idôle: bitter orange and mandarin open onto rose and jasmine, then a denser base of patchouli, vanilla and soft woods. Still clean-edged, but rounder and better suited to evenings than the airy original.
pros: Rose sits well over the patchouli-woods base
cons: Base can feel dense next to the airy original
Less distinctive than the original's clean profile

fragrances.name: 212 VIP Rosé
fragrances.description: A fizzy scent built on a rosé-champagne accord and pink pepper, softened by peach blossom and rose over a clean base of woods and white musk. Light-hearted and sweet, with an unmistakable party mood.

fragrances.name: Light Blue Eau Intense
fragrances.description: Light Blue's lemon and crisp green apple, deepened with marigold and jasmine and anchored by a warmer amberwood-and-musk base. It keeps the sunny Mediterranean feel of the original but lasts noticeably longer.
pros: Much better longevity than the original Light Blue
Bright and clean for hot days

fragrances.name: Velvet Orchid
fragrances.description: A honeyed, boozy floral: rum and honey over citrus lead into orchid, rose and jasmine, then a plush base of suede, myrrh, labdanum, vanilla and sandalwood. Sweeter and softer than Black Orchid, with a velvety, resinous finish.
pros: Easier to wear than Black Orchid

fragrances.name: Yellow Diamond
fragrances.description: A sparkling citrus-floral of lemon, bergamot, pear and neroli that softens into mimosa, orange blossom, water lily and freesia over guaiac wood, amber and musk. Bright, light and uncomplicated.
pros: Cheerful and fresh for warm days

fragrances.name: Euphoria
fragrances.description: A dark, sultry fruity amber: tart pomegranate and persimmon lead into black orchid, lotus and champaca, then a creamy base of mahogany, amber, black violet and a whipped-cream accord. Dense, sweet and clearly evening-oriented.

fragrances.name: Nomade Absolu de Parfum
fragrances.description: A denser, darker version of Nomade that sets its ripe mirabelle plum against oakmoss and fruity davana, drying down to sandalwood and musk. The fruity-chypre structure is familiar, but warmer and more concentrated.
pros: Richer and longer-lasting than Nomade EDP
cons: Oakmoss can feel dry and austere
Plum sweetness is heavier than in the original

fragrances.name: La Vie Est Belle Intensément
fragrances.description: La Vie Est Belle turned redder and richer: raspberry and pink pepper open onto heliotrope, jasmine sambac and orange blossom before settling into vanilla, iris, benzoin and patchouli. Sweet and gourmand like the original, with a jammier fruit accent.
pros: Juicy raspberry twist on a well-loved gourmand

fragrances.name: Libre Le Parfum
fragrances.description: A warmer, honeyed take on Libre: ginger, saffron and mandarin open onto the familiar lavender and orange blossom, which sit on a sweeter base of vanilla, honey and tonka. Still a floral twist on fougère, but denser and more enveloping than the EDP.
pros: Richer and warmer than Libre EDP
cons: Lavender may read masculine to some

fragrances.name: Joy by Dior
fragrances.description: A bright, clean floral where bergamot and mandarin lift a rose-and-jasmine heart touched with peach, settling onto sandalwood, cedar and white musk. Polished rather than sweet, it stays airy and unfussy.
pros: Clean, bright floral that suits daytime
cons: Can feel generic next to other Dior florals

fragrances.name: Poison Girl
fragrances.description: A bitter-orange and lemon opening gives way to a sweet rose heart and a thick base of vanilla, almond, tonka and tolu balsam. Youthful and gourmand, with a brief tart edge before the sweetness takes over.
pros: Sweet almond-vanilla gourmand with good lasting power
Orange opening adds a tart contrast
cons: Very sweet for daytime or heat

fragrances.name: Daisy Dream
fragrances.description: A breezy, watery fruity-floral where blackberry, pear and grapefruit lead into soft wisteria, lychee and jasmine, drying down to a faint coconut-water, musk and pale-wood base. Lighter and airier than the original Daisy, with a sheer, hazy feel.
cons: Can read as a generic fruity-floral

fragrances.name: Angel Muse
fragrances.description: A gourmand built on a creamy hazelnut and cocoa accord, cut with grapefruit and pink pepper and grounded by earthy patchouli and dry vetiver. Sweet but less sugary than Angel, with a nutty, textured character.
pros: Vetiver keeps the sweetness in check
cons: The nutty-earthy mix is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Aura Mugler
fragrances.description: A green-sweet scent: sharp, leafy rhubarb and bergamot over orange blossom, ylang-ylang and pear, settling into a vanilla, coumarin and wood base. The sappy green edge sets it apart from most sweet mainstream releases.
pros: Stands apart from typical sweet florals

fragrances.name: Manifesto
fragrances.description: A floral-oriental that opens with tart blackcurrant and green bergamot before a jasmine and lily-of-the-valley heart melts into a creamy vanilla and tonka base. Sweet and enveloping, with a polished evening feel.

fragrances.name: Pure Poison
fragrances.description: A luminous white floral where gardenia and orange blossom sit on a bright citrus opening, drying down to clean white musk, amber and soft woods. Radiant and polished rather than heavy, and quite distinct from the darker Poison line.
cons: Gardenia can feel loud up close

fragrances.name: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming
fragrances.description: A juicy fruity-floral of raspberry, blackcurrant and pomegranate with a pinch of pink pepper, folded into rose and peony and finished with a light white musk. Bright and rosy, it is sweeter and fruitier than Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet.
cons: Close to many other fruity-rose florals

fragrances.name: Gabrielle Chanel Essence
fragrances.description: A white-floral bouquet of tuberose, jasmine, ylang-ylang and orange blossom, opened by citrus, peach and red fruit and resting on musk, sandalwood and vanilla. Richer and more rounded than the original Gabrielle, with a creamy floral warmth.
pros: Fuller and more intense than the original Gabrielle

fragrances.name: Allure
fragrances.description: A softly blended floral where citrus and peach flow into magnolia, honeysuckle and jasmine over a smooth vanilla, vetiver and sandalwood base. Seamless and understated, it wears as one unified impression rather than distinct notes.

fragrances.name: Ange ou Démon
fragrances.description: A spicy floral-oriental that opens with saffron, mandarin and a herbal thyme accent, then moves into lily, ylang-ylang and orchid over a warm vanilla, tonka, rosewood and oakmoss base. Dark and brooding in feel, with a sweet but not sugary finish.

fragrances.name: Very Irrésistible
fragrances.description: A bright rose scent with a crisp, faintly licorice-like star anise and lemony verbena opening, followed by peony and magnolia over a soft musk, vanilla and patchouli base. Fresh and clean, it keeps the rose airy rather than jammy.
cons: The anise note is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Valentina
fragrances.description: A fruity white floral where wild strawberry and bergamot, with an earthy hint of white truffle, lead into jasmine, tuberose and orange blossom over a warm cedar, amber and vanilla base. Sweet and playful, with the truffle adding a faint savory depth.
cons: Tuberose may be too loud for some

fragrances.name: Candy Kiss
fragrances.description: A soft, cuddly musk scent sweetened with vanilla and lifted by a touch of orange blossom. Lighter and cleaner than Prada Candy, it reads more as a cosy skin scent than a dessert.

fragrances.name: Pure XS for Her
fragrances.description: A gourmand floral that pairs buttery ylang-ylang with a popcorn accord, warm vanilla and a touch of coconut and peach over soft woods and musk. Sweet and playful, it leans toward evenings and cooler weather.

fragrances.name: Jimmy Choo
fragrances.description: A fruity chypre-style scent where juicy pear and mandarin lead into orchid and a sweet toffee and patchouli base. Sweet with an earthy undertone, it moves easily from day to night.

fragrances.name: I Want Choo
fragrances.description: A sweet, glossy fruity-floral where peach and mandarin open onto jasmine and red spider lily before settling into a warm vanilla base. Party-ready and cosy, with a gourmand-leaning drydown.
